hypothesis: The deployed GGUF has no output.weight, so llama.cpp's qwen35 loader creates the output head as a TENSOR_DUPLICATED copy of token_embd (Q8_0, 248,320 x 2,048) and KleidiAI repacks it into its CPU_KLEIDIAI buffer at load. The decider never reads it: decshim always loads with embeddings on and no pooling, and P1's prefill patch returns from the qwen35 graph before the LM head; the answer comes from the numpy pointer head over hidden states. Not creating that duplicate cuts cold model_load_mmap by about the time KleidiAI spends repacking it (about 1.7 s offline, E5) and peak memory by up to the size of the repacked copy, with bit-identical answers. Restore may also change if the snapshot shrinks; that is measured, not assumed.

conclusion: Not creating the unused tied output head (LKAI_SKIP_TIED_OUTPUT=1) makes cold starts faster and every environment smaller, with every answer bit-identical. Mechanism, read from the loaded model in every environment (50 cold + 50 restore per arm): the head is skipped on all skip environments and none of ctl's, and the CPU_KLEIDIAI weight buffer is 1,998,856,192 -> 1,458,511,872 bytes (-540.3 MB, the repacked copy of token_embd). Deltas are skip minus ctl within one CPU part as read from /proc/cpuinfo (p50, 95% bootstrap CI, n ctl/skip). Cold model_load_mmap: 0xd40 8.38 -> 6.33 s (-2.05 s [-2.09, -2.00], n [42, 36]); 0xd0c -5.14 s [-5.57, -4.95] (n [3, 7]); 0xd4f -1.71 s [-1.85, -1.60] (n [5, 7]). Cold first request (Init + Duration): 0xd40 36.03 -> 33.92 s (-2.11 s [-2.20, -2.01]); 0xd0c -4.85 s; 0xd4f -1.80 s. The weight download is unchanged (0xd40 -0.063 s [-0.105, +0.010]), so the saving is load compute, not network. Restore: Restore Duration 0xd40 3.27 -> 2.92 s (-0.34 s [-0.39, -0.31]); restore first request -0.35 s [-0.39, -0.30] on 0xd40 and -0.47 s on 0xd0c (n [4, 2]); the restored first forward is unchanged (+0.002 s [-0.010, +0.014]), so the restore saving is in Restore Duration, consistent with a ~0.5 GB smaller snapshot (inferred, not measured directly). Max Memory Used: cold -492 MB, restore -494 MB, warm -503 MB on 0xd40; cold -492 / -492 MB on 0xd0c / 0xd4f. Warm inference is unchanged: 0xd40 +0.013 s [-0.084, +0.090]. Correctness: 1,200 of 1,200 answers bit-identical to P1's reference for their request and CPU part, and 600 of 600 skip answers identical to ctl's. Host variability: three CPU parts appeared (0xd40, 0xd0c, 0xd4f, read in the function; no generation inferred), and every per-part CI and every (round, part) cell has the same sign for cold model_load_mmap, cold and restore first request, Restore Duration and Max Memory, so no rerun was needed; warm inference is null on both parts. The 0xd0c and 0xd4f cells are small. 0 errors, 0 class mismatches; run cost $2.37 plus a $0.73 pilot. Recommendation: adopt; it is one environment variable on a dormant loader patch, safe while the deployment never asks llama.cpp for logits (the patched LM head aborts rather than run without the head).

delta.method: skip minus ctl, medians within each CPU part (cpuinfo, read in the function) both arms ran on; ci95 = bootstrap over environments (4,000 resamples, seed 7); cells = per (round, CPU part) medians from the interleaved rounds. Rows without a CPU part are counted, never a stratum.
